y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.a: Wannan bai bincika cewa sanin daraja kawai ba ya tantance ma’aunan aikin quadratic guda ɗaya.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.b: Wannan ya yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa f(2)=0 da gangara f′(2)=3 suna tantance aikin layi gaba ɗaya.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.c: f aikin cubic ne kuma f(0)=−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.c: Wannan ya ɗauka ƙara ƙimar aiki guda ya tantance shi. Aikin cubic yana da ma’aunai da dama, saboda haka ƙima guda ta bar ma’auni guda ba a tantance ba.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.d: f aikin cubic ne kuma f(1)=−3.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ya ɗauka an tantance aiki saboda ya yi daidai da ƙimar wani aikin layi. Wasu ayyuka na iya samun ƙima iri ɗaya.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.e: f aikin quadratic ne kuma f(0)=−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.e: Wannan ya ƙara darajar aikin da ƙima guda, ya daidaita adadin ma’aunan da ake nema da adadin sharuddan.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.explain: f(2)=0 da f′(2)=3 sun riga sun zama sharudda biyu. Aikin layi yana da ma’aunai biyu, saboda haka an tantance shi a matsayin f(x)=3(x−2), kuma f(3)=3. Idan aka bayar tare da aikin quadratic da f(0)=−2, an tantance shi a matsayin f(x)=(x−2)(x+1), don haka f(3)=4. Sanin quadratic kaɗai ba ya tantance f(3)=p+3 (p ma’aunin x² ne), kuma ƙara ƙima guda ga aikin cubic yana barin ma’auni guda.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.prompt: Muna son nuna cewa ƙara “f aikin quadratic ne” kaɗai bai isa ba. Ga f(x)=ax²+bx+c (a, b, c cikakkun lambobi ne, a≠0), ƙirƙiri ayyuka 2 da suka cika sharuddan baya (f(2)=0, f′(2)=3) amma f(3) nasu ya bambanta.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi a guda, ka rubuta yadda za a tantance b da c daga sharuddan biyun.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙirƙiri ayyuka biyu masu a mabambanta, sannan ka lissafta f(3) ga kowanne ka kwatanta.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.ok.c1: a cikakkiyar lamba ce marar sifili; b da c ma cikakkun lambobi ne.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c1: Tun da aikin quadratic ne, a dole ya zama cikakkiyar lamba marar sifili, b da c kuma cikakkun lambobi.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c2: f(2), da aka samu ta saka x=2, ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.ok.c3: f(x)/(x−2) yana matsowa 3 yayin da x ke matsowa 2.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c3: f(x)/(x−2) ba ya matsowa 3 yayin da x ke matsowa 2. Duba furucin da kaso yake zama idan f(2)=0, da ƙimar furucin idan aka saka 2.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.explain: Idan muka rubuta f(x)=(x−2)(px+q), to f′(2)=2p+q=3, don haka q=3−2p, kuma f(3)=p+3. Idan p ya canza, f(3) ma yana canzawa. Misali, idan f(x)=x²−x−2, to f(3)=4; idan f(x)=2x²−5x+2, to f(3)=5.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.prompt: A cikin jimloli ɗaya ko biyu, bayyana yadda ayyukan biyun da ka ƙirƙira suke nuna cewa “sanin aikin quadratic ne kaɗai ba ya tantance f(3)”.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Da farko rubuta jimla da ke tabbatar ko f(2) da f′(2) iri ɗaya ne ga ayyukan biyun da ka gina.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Rubuta ƙimomin f(3) na ayyukan biyun gefe da gefe, ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta gaskiyoyi biyun: ayyukan biyun sun cika sharudda iri ɗaya, kuma f(3) nasu ya bambanta?
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ka ƙara da cewa “saboda haka ana buƙatar ƙarin bayani”?
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.0: x²−x−2 da 2x²−5x+2 duka sun cika f(2)=0 da f′(2)=3, amma f(3) nasu ya bambanta: 4 da 5. Don haka sanin aikin quadratic ne kaɗai ba ya tantance f(3), kuma ana buƙatar ƙarin bayani.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.1: Ayyukan quadratic biyu sun cika sharudda iri ɗaya amma f(3) ya zama ƙimomi mabambanta. Ba a tantance amsa guda ba ƙarƙashin sharudda iri ɗaya, don haka bayanin bai wadatar ba.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.2: Ko a ya bambanta, ana iya sa f(2)=0 da f′(2)=3 su zama iri ɗaya, kuma f(3)=a+3, don haka f(3) yana bambanta ga kowane a. Saboda haka bayanin cewa aikin quadratic ne kaɗai bai isa sanin f(3) ba.

y-m-63-05.title: A ina ne lissafin Hajun ya fara kuskure?
y-m-63-05.topic: Nemo abin da aka samu na ayyukan polynomial: duba kurakuran mafitar da ta yi amfani da ka’idar ninkawa
y-m-63-05.goal: A mafitar nemo abin da aka samu na aikin da aka bayar a matsayin ninkawa, gano layin da ke da kuskure, bayyana cewa samun ƙima iri ɗaya a wuri guda ba ya tabbatar da mafitar daidai ce, sannan ka gyara rubutun.
y-m-63-05.material:
Hajun ya nemo f′(x) na f(x)=(x²+1)(x³−x kamar haka. (Ana karanta x² “x squared”, x³ kuma “x cubed”.)
Layin su ne na 1, na 2, na 3, da na 4 daga sama.
y-m-63-05.thinking.0: Karanta mafitar layi bayan layi, ka duba ƙa’idoji
y-m-63-05.thinking.1: Kimanta ko daidaito a wuri guda hujja ce da ta wadatar
y-m-63-05.thinking.2: Gyara kuskuren daidai, ka bayyana dalili
y-m-63-05.prereq.1: Abin da aka samu na xⁿ, da nemo abin da aka samu na jimla da bambancin polynomials
y-m-63-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko a mafitar Hajun da aka yi amfani da ƙa’ida ba daidai ba.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta da kalmomi ƙa’idar da aka yi amfani da ita a kowane layi.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bayyana ƙa’idar kowane layi da kalmomi; yi amfani da ita ga ninkawa mai sauƙi kamar x·x, buɗe shi ka nemo abin da aka samu kai tsaye, sannan ka kwatanta sakamakon.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Abin da aka samu na ninkawar ayyuka biyu ba g′(x)h′(x) ba ne, sai dai g′(x)h(x)+g(x)h′(x). A misali mai sauƙi x·x, ninkawar abubuwan da aka samu ita ce 1·1=1, amma abin da aka samu na x² shi ne 2x. Layuka 1 da 2 daidai ne, layi na 4 kuma lissafi ne kawai na sakamakon layi na 3.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.prompt: Hajun ya ce, “Na samu 4 ga f′(1) sa’ad da na nemo abin da aka samu na furucin x⁵−x, wanda na samu ta buɗe ninkawar da farko. Sakamakon nawa ma 4 ne, saboda haka mafitar daidai ce!” Wane hukunci ne ya dace game da wannan magana?
y-m-63-05.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi wata ƙima ban da x=1, ka lissafta sakamakon Hajun da kuma sakamakon nemo abin da aka samu bayan buɗewa.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa idan furuci biyu iri ɗaya ne, dole su yi daidai a kowane x.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.a: x=1 ƙaramin lamba ne, ba gwaji na gaske ba. Ya kamata a gwada babban lamba kamar 100.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauka girman ƙimar gwajin ne matsalar. Muhimmin abu shi ne a gwada a wurare mabambanta.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.b: Daidaito a wuri guda na iya zama kwatsam. Ya kamata a duba wasu x ma.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.b: Wannan bai yanke hukunci daga daidaito a wuri guda ba, ya kuma gwada zaɓin wasu ƙimomi.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.c: Daidai ne. Hanyoyin biyun sun ba da ƙima iri ɗaya, don haka mafitar ma daidai ce.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.c: Wannan ya ɗauki samun ƙima guda a wuri ɗaya a matsayin hujjar cewa furucin biyun iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.d: Ba daidai ba ne. Bai yi amfani da ka’idar ninkawa ba, don haka ƙimomin ba za su yi daidai ba.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ya gauraya kuskuren hanya da daidaiton ƙima a wuri guda. Hanya mara kyau ma na iya ba da ƙima iri ɗaya bisa kwatsam.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.explain: A x=1, duka sun zama 4 bisa kwatsam. A x=2, furucin Hajun yana ba da 6·8−4=44, amma furucin 5x⁴−1 da aka samu ta buɗewa yana ba da 79; sun bambanta. Daidaito a wuri guda ba hujja ba ce cewa furucin iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta layi na 3 na Hajun daidai don nemo f′(x) na gaskiya, ka gaya masa cikin jimla guda abin da bai daidai ba.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo abin da aka samu na furucin da aka samu ta buɗe ninkawar.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta tsarin ka’idar ninkawa da kanka, sannan ka kwatanta ko sakamakon hanyoyin biyun iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka kwatanta f′(x) da ka rubuta da furucin Hajun a x=2, ka tabbatar sun bambanta?
y-m-63-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin kuskuren bisa ƙa’idar da ta dace, ba kawai cewa “ƙa’ida ta bambanta” ba?
y-m-63-05.s.s3.model.0: Ta ka’idar ninkawa, f′(x)=g′h+gh′=2x(x³−x)+(x²+1)(3x²−1)=5x⁴−1. Dole ne a yi amfani da ka’idar ninkawa, ba a ninka abubuwan da aka samu ba.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.model.1: Idan aka fara buɗewa, f(x)=x⁵−x, saboda haka f′(x)=5x⁴−1. Hajun ya ninka abubuwan da aka samu dabam-dabam, amma ba haka ake nemo abin da aka samu na ninkawa ba.

y-m-63-07.title: Shin akwai layin tangent guda ɗaya kawai da ya ratsa wurin P?
y-m-63-07.topic: Ƙa'idar layin tangent: layukan tangent da aka zana daga wani wuri a wajen lanƙwasa
y-m-63-07.goal: A yayin nemo layukan tangent da aka zana daga wurin da ba ya kan lanƙwasa, bambanta wurin taɓawa da wurin da layin ya ratsa, sannan ka tabbatar kai tsaye cewa akwai yiwuwar samun layukan tangent da dama.
y-m-63-07.material:
Akwai lanƙwasa y=x² da wurin P(1, −3). (Karanta 'y ita ce x murabba'i'.) Idan x=1, ƙimar y ta lanƙwasa ita ce 1, saboda haka P ba ya kan lanƙwasa. Nara ta warware kamar haka.
"Idan f(x)=x², to f′(x)=2x kuma f′(1)=2. Don haka layin tangent mai gangara 2 da ya ratsa P(1, −3) shi ne y−(−3)=2(x−1), wato y=2x−5."
Layin tangent layi ne da ya ratsa wani wuri a kan lanƙwasa (wurin taɓawa), gangarensa kuma asalawar lanƙwasa ce a wannan wurin.
y-m-63-07.thinking.1: Ɗauki wurin taɓawa a matsayin wanda ba a sani ba, sannan ka cika sharuddan
y-m-63-07.thinking.2: Yi tunani kan adadin layukan tangent bisa matsayin wurin
y-m-63-07.prereq.1: Ma'anar geometric ta asalawa (gangaren layin tangent) da asalawar aiki mai quadratic kamar y=x²
y-m-63-07.s.s1.hint.0: Duba da lissafi ko layin da Nara ta samu da lanƙwasa suna haɗuwa a wani wuri.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta wurin lanƙwasa inda gangara 2 take da haɗin gwiwarsa da wurin P.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.a: An yi kuskuren lissafi wajen samo f′(x)=2x, kuma saka x=1 cikin sa ma ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.a: Lissafin asalawa daidai ne. Wannan hukunci bai bincika gangara 2 a wane wuri take ba.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.b: Gangara 2 ita ce ƙimar gangara a wurin (1, 1) na lanƙwasa, amma P ba wurin taɓawa ba ne.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya bambanta gangara a wurin taɓawa da wurin da layin ya ratsa.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya amfani da rubuta ƙa'idar layi da y−y₁=m(x−x₁) ga layukan tangent ba.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ya ɗauki siffar ƙa'idar layi a matsayin matsalar. Siffar ƙa'idar daidai ce; matsalar ita ce ma'anar ƙimomin da aka saka.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.d: Ba za a iya zana layin tangent daga wurin da haɗin gwiwarsa ya ƙunshi lamba mara kyau ba.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ya ɗauki alamar haɗin gwiwar wurin a matsayin mai yanke ko layin tangent zai samuwa.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.explain: f′(1)=2 ita ce gangara a wurin (1, 1) na lanƙwasa. P ba ya kan lanƙwasa, don haka ba wurin taɓawa ba ne. A gaskiya, warware y=2x−5 da y=x² tare yana ba da x²−2x+5=0, wanda ba shi da tushen ainihi, saboda haka wannan layin bai ma taɓa lanƙwasar ba.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.prompt: Nemo duk layukan tangent na y=x² da suka ratsa wurin P(1, −3). Shigar da nau'i-nau'i 2 daban-daban na haɗin gwiwar x t na wurin taɓawa da gangara m na layin tangent.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.hint.0: A ce wurin taɓawa shi ne (t, t²), sannan ka bayyana ƙa'idar layin tangent a wannan wurin ta amfani da t.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.hint.1: Saka x=1, y=−3 cikin wannan layi domin samun lissafin da t dole ya cika, sannan ka gwada ƙimomin t.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.ok.c1: m yana daidai da asalawar a wurin taɓawa (t, t²).
y-m-63-07.s.s2.fail.c1: m ya bambanta da asalawar lanƙwasa a haɗin gwiwar x t na wurin taɓawa. Saka t cikin asalawar y=x².
y-m-63-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Wannan layin tangent yana ratsa wurin P(1, −3).
y-m-63-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan wurin taɓawa shi ne (t, t²), wannan layin tangent ba ya ratsa wurin P(1, −3). Duba ko ƙimar ƙa'idar layin tangent a x=1 ita ce −3.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.explain: Idan wurin taɓawa shi ne (t, t²), layin tangent shi ne y=2t(x−t)+t²=2tx−t². Domin ya ratsa P(1, −3), dole −3=2t−t², wato t²−2t−3=0, don haka t=3 ko t=−1. Akwai layukan tangent biyu: y=6x−9 da y=−2x−1.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.prompt: Ga lanƙwasa y=x², wane zaɓi ne ya dace ya daidaita adadin layukan tangent da za a iya zana daga maki Q₁(1, 1), Q₂(1, −3), da Q₃(1, 2)?
y-m-63-07.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta da y₀ ƙa'idar da wurin taɓawa t na layin tangent da ya ratsa wurin (1, y₀) dole ya cika.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.hint.1: Duba alamar discriminant na wannan lissafi, tare da la'akari da girman y₀.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.a: Q₁ yana da 1, Q₂ yana da 2, Q₃ kuma yana da 0.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya yi tunani kan adadin tushen lissafin wurin taɓawa idan wurin yana kan lanƙwasa, a ƙasanta, da sama da ita.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.b: Q₁ yana da 2, Q₂ yana da 1, Q₃ kuma yana da 0.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.b: Wannan tunani ya ga layukan tangent biyu ko da daga wurin da ke kan lanƙwasa. Ka lura cewa wurin taɓawa shi ne wurin kansa.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.c: Q₁ yana da 1, Q₂ yana da 0, Q₃ kuma yana da 2.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.c: Wannan tunani ya musanya matsayen ƙasan lanƙwasa da samanta. Zana hoton parabola mai buɗewa sama.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.d: Maki ukun duka suna da layukan tangent 2.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.d: Wannan tunani ya ɗauka cewa koyaushe akwai layukan tangent biyu ba tare da la'akari da matsayin wurin ba.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.explain: Wurin taɓawar layin tangent da aka zana daga (1, y₀) yana cika y₀=2t−t², wato t²−2t+y₀=0. Discriminant 4−4y₀ yana tabbatacce idan y0<1 (layukan tangent 2), 0 idan y0=1 (1), kuma mara kyau idan y0>1 (0). Q₁ yana da 1, Q₂ yana da 2, Q₃ kuma yana da 0.

y-m-63-01.material: An ayyana aikin f da f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2) idan x≠2. (Karanta shi da 'x murabba'i a cire 4' a raba da 'x a cire 2'.) Ba a bayar da ƙimar a x=2 da farko.
